name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: New Air Force One going out of commission to get safety upgrades
changes.summary: The new Air Force One is going out of commission to receive safety upgrades. What needs to be done and was it safe for President Trump to fly the plane to Turkey earlier this month?

changes.title: The U.S. Is Pulling Back on Energy Efficiency
changes.summary: The Trump administration is undoing fuel-saving efforts even as war in Iran, data centers and heat waves are pushing up gasoline and electricity costs.

changes.title: Ex-U.S. attorney in Seattle sues Trump over firing
changes.summary: Roger Rogoff was fired from his role as U.S. attorney in Seattle shortly after judges on the U.S. District Court for the Western District of Washington appointed him to the job.

changes.title: Markets undeterred so far as Trump imposes additional 50% tariffs on some Canadian goods
changes.summary: President Trump plans to impose a new 50% tariff on certain Canadian goods in addition to his existing tariffs. CBS News' Kelly O'Grady explains the tariffs and investor reaction.

changes.title: Trump admin. halts $1 billion in Medicaid payments to California, Minnesota
changes.summary: Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. said his agency is pausing $867.5 million in Medicaid payments to California and $199 million to Minnesota.

changes.title: Trump to impose 50% tariffs on Canadian hockey sticks, alcohol, other goods
changes.summary: President Trump is imposing 50% tariffs on a range of Canadian goods, from hockey equipment to alcoholic beverages, escalating the trade dispute between the two countries.

changes.title: Trump says Lebanon has been "badly treated" as Aoun pushes for withdrawal of Israeli troops
changes.summary: President Trump conceded that Lebanon has been "badly treated" following a meeting with President Joseph Aoun on Tuesday, pledging to help the country be "properly treated" as the Lebanese reprieve from the presence of Israeli forces in their southern territory. Weijia Jiang reports.

changes.title: Trump hits Canada with slew of new 50% tariffs set to take effect in 30 days
changes.summary: President Trump takes aim at Canada with his latest round of tariffs hitting a variety of goods at 50%.

changes.title: Former Canadian finance minister on Trump's tariff plan and its impact
changes.summary: NPR's Juana Summers speaks with Chrystia Freeland, former Canadian Finance Minister, about the potential impact of President Trump's proposed tariffs.

changes.title: Trump says U.S. would have to 'take care' of potential Houthi blockade of Red Sea
changes.summary: Asked about his level of concern about a blockade of the Red Sea by the Iranian-backed Houthi rebels, President Donald Trump suggested Tuesday it wasn't an immediate problem.
